descriptionHtml:
The "Tune IT 2.0" workshop and competition are designed to provide participants with a comprehensive understanding of radio technology through theoretical and practical experiences. Organized by the IEEE ComSoc Student Branch Chapter of the University of Peradeniya, this event aims to introduce undergraduates to the fundamentals and advanced aspects of radio technology, which is crucial in modern telecommunication systems.

"Tune IT 2.0" is a Radio Technology Workshop consisting of several events like a knowledgeable session on Radio Technology, Fox Hunt, and a Competition. The workshop session is highly focused on giving the idea of Radio Technology and also to give the desired technical knowledge to make a Radio on their own during the session. This workshop session will be conducted by the expertise of the Radio Society of Sri Lanka who has the ability and professional experience to guide young minds through the Radio Technology theories. The purpose of the event is to give the participants a chance to learn a vast and deep area under the topic Radio Technology in a creative, simple as well as in an interesting manner. Therefore, the program will not only consist of a workshop but there will be an interactive assessment to make a Radio during the workshop.
